model.name: diffEditor.absoluteBlankReanchor
model.description: A single forward pass tracks cumulative visual rows per pane and, at every diff3 stable/blank anchor, re-anchors each pane to the max (pads laggards) before emitting - snapping any single-region mis-pad to 0 at the next anchor (self-healing, 0px at all anchors). Impl-edit to computeMergedCenter + alignPaneRows; markers stay.
